mission: SNKRDUNK coverage gap (owner task 2026-10-18, diagnostic only): add four reviewed read-only db-diagnostic files that classify every active verified high-rarity print (all but base C, UC, R and SR) without a fresh SNKRDUNK raw price into never discovered, discovered but unresolved (with listing kind: plain, parallel, SP, manga), mapped but not refreshed, probably not sold raw, and other; plus coverage by release, 14 days of discovery activity and first raw prices, and samples. Register them in ops-readonly. Staging only; PSA10 not read; no rule, alias, proposal, mapping, enqueue, collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: Four SELECT/WITH-only diagnostics (11 statements) over card_prints, canonical_cards, release_products, sources, source_card_mappings, freshness_work, freshness_price_states, freshness_attempts, source_mapping_proposal_groups, snkrdunk_candidates, snkrdunk_discovery_runs and price_observations (raw floor only), run only in the existing default_transaction_read_only db-diagnostic session with its statement timeout. No write, no source request.

Adds snkrdunk-coverage-gap, snkrdunk-coverage-gap-discovery, snkrdunk-coverage-gap-releases and snkrdunk-coverage-gap-samples to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic (four new read-only SQL files)

dependencies: ops runbooks from PR #139, #143, #150, #155, #157, #158; diagnostics from PR #156 and #166 (unchanged)
impact.deployment_impact: Four read-only diagnostics and their workflow choice entries. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes; snkrdunk and yuyutei collectors untouched.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the four diagnostics and their workflow choices. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run of a new file that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or returns anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic run per new file, dispatched one at a time, completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries rows or names them in rows_omitted.
